title: Nominalisation — verb to noun
examples: They analysed the data → The analysis of the data...
Sales improved → There was an improvement in sales.
We decided → A decision was made.
pattern: Turn key verbs/adjectives into nouns to densify formal prose
explanation: Nominalisation is common in academic and professional writing because it packages actions as concepts.
explanationIt: La nominalizzazione è comune nella scrittura accademica e professionale perché trasforma azioni in concetti.
realUse: The analysis of the findings suggests a substantial improvement.

options: The analysis of the findings suggests improvement.
